text:
As Year-end Budgets Tighten, Zil Money’s Virtual Cards Help SMBs to Close the Books Cleanly
TYLER, TX, USA - Nov 6, 2025 - Zil Money, a leading B2B payments platform, is highlighting its virtual card offering as a financial control tool for businesses managing end-of-year spending. The company says rising Q4 purchasing activity and tighter departmental budgets are driving adoption, with more firms using virtual cards to enforce policy rules and speed up reconciliation.
The push for more disciplined, real-time spend control has made virtual cards a preferred tool for finance teams heading into Q4. Zil Money’s cloud-based platform issues virtual cards on demand from a business wallet and assigns them to employees, departments, or projects. Administrators set per-transaction, daily, or monthly limits and can restrict usage by merchant category or location. Authorizations occur in real time—typically in under two seconds—and transactions are paired with AI-driven receipt capture and categorization to accelerate audit preparation and year-end close.
“As businesses work to close their books, every spending decision counts,” said Sabeer Nelli, CEO of Zil Money Corporation. “Our Virtual Cards give finance teams instant visibility into expenses and enforceable budgets so they can make confident, data-driven decisions at year-end.”
Finance leaders report tangible gains. With each transaction flowing directly into accounting systems, reconciliations close faster, audits run smoother, and budgets hold firm. The Virtual Cards mobile app, launched earlier this year, gives administrators real-time visibility and approval control from anywhere.
About Zil Money Corporation
Zil Money is a cloud-based payments platform providing business payment solutions including check printing, ACH transfers, wire transfers, international payments, and virtual cards. The platform serves over one million businesses and integrates thousands of banks and major accounting systems. It has processed over $100 billion in transactions and is accessible via web browsers as well as mobile apps for iOS and Android.
